BuildingBrickCorner.obj.author: Daniel Zhabotinsky
BuildingBrickCorner.obj.changes: Converted the selected building from the set (node transforms baked, metres, Y up); shared 2K atlases resized to 1K JPG and renamed DT_*; metallicRoughness maps (near-constant) folded into material constants; no vertex normals written (flat facades); 3,261 tris. Revision 2026-10-15: the Sketchfab export lost the opacity of the Maskedstuff atlas (opaque JPEG composited on black), so the fire-escape cards rendered as near-black slabs; Source~/masked_details.py rebuilds the alpha from brightness (max RGB ramp 8 -> 20, 3 -> 8 in the dim chain-link band; specks < 4 px removed), lifts thin wires darker than 40/255 towards 40 (gain <= 4), bleeds colour into transparent texels and saves DT_MaskedDetails_Color.png; the OBJ gets 228 back-face triangles (reversed winding, own vertices) for the masked cards: 3,489 tris.
